Legs.Subject: Explicit mode preservation, hand-calculated width crossover boundaries at squares 10^12 and 10^14, complete proof boundary 65537 squared, prime-state memory admission at 10^16 and refusal at 10^18 and the full ulong interval, empty intervals, fixed bitmap sizes and named invalid options. This pins a chosen cost policy, not a universal optimality assertion.

Pre-canceled ordinary and reversed intervals throw before callbacks. Callback cancellation throws before another one-byte segment, including final and exceptional-prime callbacks, both layouts and modes, and intervals requiring upper-base generation. Cancellation preserves its token; a fresh call remains usable. ENVELOPE: cancellation during asynchronous base generation and native resource reclamation are inspected in source, not independently instrumented by this law.
Count and ordered enumeration cross 65537 squared in tiny segments with both layouts and pattern choices; the square must be rejected while proven smaller survivors remain.
Legs.Against: Oracles.ExactPrimality uses integer trial division and BigInteger witnesses without the sieve, wheel coordinates or Lucas recurrence. ENVELOPE: correctness at the proof boundary is checked; the saved code inspection establishes omission of unnecessary decisions below it.

Legs.Subject: A reversed constellation interval produces no callbacks; invalid options, including a segment beyond Array.MaxLength, are rejected by parameter name even for an empty interval and a pattern whose ordinary wheel mask is zero.
